title: Page Descriptions, 65 level cap, other changes

texts: Added more comprehensive descriptions to most pages on the site.
Changed the default and max level of identities to 65.
Adjusted the release history page so that it doesn't shrink items when too many are on the same row.
Added the façade and wishlist update in company to the manager's guide.
Fixed an issue where clicking on a link to the current page would still trigger the loading bar causing it to linger indefinitely or until the user navigates to another page.
Implemented some background preparation and compliance for introducing ads to the site.
